evidence: SCAN-CONFIRMED 1908-09 SP ballet p005 prints Голейзовскій among the graduating воспитанники. Kasyan Goleizovsky (Wikidata Q19974678): graduated the Petersburg school 1909, transferred to the Bolshoi 1 Aug 1909, which is exactly where the Moscow roster picks him up in 1909-10. The yearbook's patronymic Карловичъ is NOT a conflict with the usual Ярославич: his Czech father Ярославъ Матвеевичъ was baptised Карлъ-Ярославъ. The о/а split tracks the CITY -- Petersburg sources (1905-06 Graduates, this review) print Голейзовск-, Moscow rosters Галейзовск-.

SCAN-CONFIRMED 1904-05 SP ballet p009 prints one н where the rosters print two. No ordinal in the review, and the rosters hold two Солянниковъ (Владиміръ Александровичъ 1-й and Николай Александровичъ), so this maps to the SURNAME and the ranker chooses.

SCAN-CONFIRMED review_1903-04_SP_ballet_p002 prints Лопухина at 8x -- Л-о-п-у-х-и-н-а, the и and н unmistakable. A GENUINE PRINT TYPO for Лопухова, not a person: Евгенія Лопухова is in the 1903-04 SP BalletArtists roster, that exact season; the same season's reviews print Лопухова five more times (p009, p012, p013, p016, p017); Лопухина occurs once in the whole corpus; and no Лопухина exists in any ballet list -- the only Лопухинъ is Николай Николаевичъ, an Administrator, a different family. Maps to the surname, so the ranker picks the season-appropriate Лопухова.
